name: ask-twice
description: A 9:16 stick-figure short rendered from code, with a sound-effect mix

scripts.walktest: for m in heavy forced walk jog run; do node scripts/render.js --test walk --mood $m && node scripts/render.js --test walk --mood $m --track; done
scripts.build: node scripts/check.js && node scripts/render.js && node scripts/mix.js
scripts.iewy:check: FILM=it-ends-with-you node scripts/check.js && FILM=it-ends-with-you node scripts/popcheck.js
scripts.iewy:build: npm run iewy:check && npm run iewy:render && npm run iewy:mix
scripts.phone:check: FILM=i-wish-i-was-your-phone node scripts/check.js && FILM=i-wish-i-was-your-phone node scripts/popcheck.js
scripts.phone:build: npm run phone:check && npm run phone:render && npm run phone:mix
scripts.mot:check: FILM=motivation node scripts/check.js && FILM=motivation node scripts/popcheck.js
scripts.mot:build: npm run mot:check && npm run mot:render && npm run mot:mix
